title: Define gated retry profiles and stream-safe idempotency semantics across SDKs
creator: Maya Chen
description: Context: Multiple SDKs currently expose different retry behaviors and idempotency assumptions. This causes customer confusion and production incidents when requests are retried across streaming and non-streaming endpoints. Goal: Define conservative, gated retry profiles (fast-fail, conservative, aggressive) and a single cross-SDK idempotency metadata model that is safe for streaming (resume-able) and non-streaming calls. Deliverables: 1) Spec with default retry/backoff parameters for Python/TS/Go and migration knobs; 2) Idempotency key API surface and guidance for server-side validation; 3) Retryable error taxonomy and mapping table (which codes are safe to retry by profile); 4) Streaming resume token format and guidance for SDKs; 5) Tests, examples, and SDK changelogs.
acceptance_criteria:
1) Documented default retry profiles included in SDK reference for Python/TS/Go.
2) SDKs implement a common idempotency header (Idempotency-Key or X-Redwood-Idempotency) and a streaming Resume-Token convention.
3) Retries do not duplicate at-least-once side effects when idempotency header is present and validated.
4) Compatibility tests covering transient network errors, 429 throttling, 5xx, and model timeouts.
5) Migration guide and sample code snippets for each language included in repo: examples/retries/
comments: 2026-02-21 - Maya C: Kickoff meeting notes posted (link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/SDK/Retry+Profiles+Kickoff). Agreed on three profiles: fast-fail, conservative, aggressive. PM requested explicit defaults for public API endpoints.

2026-02-25 - Diego A: Drafted backoff formula: jittered exponential backoff with base_delay=100ms, factor=2.0, max_delay=5s, max_attempts depends on profile (fast-fail=1, conservative=3, aggressive=6). Shared prototype in internal repo: github.com/redwood/sdk-retries/tree/feature/eng-128999

2026-03-02 - Review (PM - Anika Rao): Prefer lowering aggressive defaults for streaming endpoints to avoid long-lived ambiguous sessions; suggested stream profile override where max_attempts<=2 and rely on resume-token semantics.
2026-03-04 - Design (Samir Patel): UX note - surface current retry profile in SDK telemetry and Console so customers can see retried requests count. Added console-metrics stub to observability plan.

2026-03-06 - Diego A: Introduced idempotency header proposal: X-Redwood-Idempotency (UUIDv4 recommended) with optional intent field (X-Redwood-Idempotency-Intent) for human-readable grouping. For streaming, Resume-Token schema is base64(urlsafe): {session_id}:{seq}:{crc32} signed by server nonce. See spec link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/sdk/retry-specs

2026-03-08 - Engineering sync: Decided to gate aggressive profile behind explicit opt-in flag in SDKs (e.g., client.withRetryProfile('aggressive')). Default for hosted endpoints will be 'conservative'.

2026-03-09 - Diego A: Implemented unit tests for retryable taxonomy mapping (transient network errors, ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT -> retryable; 429 -> retryable with rate-limit-backoff; 4xx client errors other than 409 conflict -> non-retryable). Pushed PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-retries/pull/142

2026-03-10 - Maya C (PM): Requested a clear migration note for customers using custom idempotency patterns. Also asked for sample snippets for Python/TS/Go showing resume-token usage with streaming clients.
